_doc: Game camera (client only; src/client/camera.ts). chase: distance behind, height above and look-ahead of the skater (m), field of view (deg); fast: how much each grows between from and to m/s (the sense of speed when bombing); air: extra height and distance while airborne; follow and aim: how quickly position and aim catch up per tick (0..1); turn: how quickly the camera swings behind a new heading. collide: the camera never sits inside park geometry: at each of lifts (m) it tries swinging around the skater by each of swing (deg) to see past what is in the way, preferring a spot in the open (tight.openWidth), then slides in toward the skater, keeping margin from the surface, and keeps a clearance sphere from anything beside the lens. Cars (the sim's, within carRange m of the skater) block the line of sight like geometry, and the camera keeps cars m from them, its smoothed position too (a car driving into it pushes it aside or up). The line of sight is tested with a ray and a swept sphere of radius probe (fences are separate bars a ray slips between). kick: a short vertical shake on landings (scaled by the drop) and bails; a landing also dips the camera by dip m (for a 1.5 m drop, at most 1.5 times that) and lets it back up, deepest after dipTicks ticks (the filmer's knees); a step in one tick that the velocity does not explain, on the ground or in the air (a curb hop, a kerb, the ledge pop: 3 to 45 cm) is taken out of the camera's height and eased back in by a critically damped spring of stepRate rad/s. special: while a special trick runs the camera comes in (dist, height as fractions) and swings side degrees round, easing in and out at those rates per tick. tight: how narrow it is round the skater, from the space across the way it looks (walls left and right, each looked for out to reach m): narrow at narrow m wide, open from open m, eased at rate per tick; measured probeHeight m over the skater, above parked cars and benches; narrow, the camera comes in by dist (fraction), rises height m, looks down lookDown m and keeps only 1 - fovKick of the speed's field-of-view kick; a lens spot is in the open when it has openWidth m across. grind: after a grind or slide has run after ticks the camera eases (inRate, outRate per tick) side degrees round to the approach side and lift m up, so the board on the rail shows, and follows the rail at turn. vert: in a vert air the camera eases back dist m and up height m and aims look m lower (the landing in frame), out at outRate. bomb: from from to to m/s the camera goes dist m nearer, height m lower, aims lookHeight m lower, widens fov degrees, and lags less (follow, aim and turn instead of chase's), eased at rate; shake: from shake[0] to shake[1] m/s a very slight quick tremor up to shake[2] m (off with Reduce motion). Handrails (grind lines of kind rail) are draw-only: within rails m of one sideways the camera rises to rails m above it (else it can sit just under a stair rail it follows down, the rail filling the frame). punch: a goal completed: the camera pushes in by dist (fraction) and narrows fov degrees over ticks, in fast, out slower, still following. drive: in a vehicle (src/sim/game/vehicles.ts; the skater sits at its seat), the camera sits dist m behind and height m above the seat, looks lookAhead m ahead and lookHeight m above it, with fov; from fast.from to fast.to m/s each grows by fast's amount; the skating moods (tight, grind, vert, bomb, special, punch) are off.
